title: MIRL Lacuna: a catalogue of an absent archive
description: A no-build, local-first cataloguer for archives that no longer exist: destroyed, damaged, looted, dispersed, and unlocated works recorded with evidence hashes, consent states down to the entry, a register of narrators whose identities never publish, dated sightings, status histories, loss events, typed relations, surviving copies (IIIF), a memorial register, a timeline, an atlas of consented places, CSV import, serverless merge, fixity checks, passphrase encryption of the working file, and self-contained finding-aid and memorial-book exports. Arabic and right-to-left ready.

creators.name: O'Brien, Jeff
